name: io.github.CTRLabs/ctrl-mcp
title: CTRL
description: Visual DeFi workflow automation on Base + Ethereum mainnet. Compose triggers (cron, price, balance, pool.created for Clanker/Flaunch/Zora/BANKR, watch.whale) and actions (Uniswap V4 swaps, USDC payouts, Telegram/Discord notifications) on a canvas. User signs ONCE via EIP-5792; an 8-wallet keeper executes from vault-direct V13 smart contracts forever, bounded by per-swap and per-day caps. No session keys, no delegated approvals.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer sk_ctrl_... — mint at https://ctrl.build/settings/api-keys for higher rate limits. The REST + MCP paths are also anonymous-friendly (security boundary is the wallet signature at activate-time, not the API key).
